# Cosmetic & Bariatric Treatment Cost in India for Patients from Kenya

**In short:** Understand what you can expect to pay for cosmetic and weight-loss surgery in India, why so many Kenyan patients travel for care, and how we help you plan every step.

## Why patients from Kenya choose India

- **Significant cost savings:** Treatment in India is typically a fraction of what you would pay in the US or Europe, without compromising on quality.
- **Accredited hospitals:** We connect you with JCI/NABH-accredited facilities that maintain strict international safety standards.
- **Short waits:** Appointment and surgery dates are usually available within weeks, not months, so you can focus on your health sooner.
- **Experienced specialists:** Indian surgeons often have international training and extensive experience treating patients from across Africa and the Middle East.

## Your 5-step patient journey

1. **WhatsApp reports:** Send us your recent medical reports and basic details via WhatsApp.

## FAQ

**Is it safe to have surgery in India?**
Yes. The hospitals we work with are JCI/NABH-accredited and follow strict international patient safety protocols. We only facilitate care at facilities that meet these standards.

**How long will I need to stay in India?**
This depends on your procedure and recovery. Bariatric patients typically stay around 7–10 days. Your surgeon will give you a specific recommendation before you travel.

**Do I pay the hospital directly?**
Yes. You pay the hospital directly for your treatment. We do not handle your medical funds.
